g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class A1 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 5.6 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: NO. NDE: 10 % RT of BW.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Pump suction: no pockets, header falls to pumps; eccentric reducers 20"x16" FLAT ON TOP; temporary strain
7. Pump nozzle 16" assumed (API 610 vendor data pending).
8. Rack high point vented; tank static head gives NPSH margin (check at detailed design).
9. Header at y = pump nozzle + 1.5 m limited by E-106A/B (layout) - see RPT-001 issues.
